task.title: Add the Test Index and Documentation Reconciliation Gate

metrics.coverageNote: This task generates and validates documentation indexes; runtime coverage was not re-measured, so null is reported rather than a fabricated percentage.

tdd.red: scripts/verification/reconcile-index.test.ts was added before the implementation and failed because ./reconcile-index did not exist. After implementation, the live --check gate failed with four DocumentationDriftDetected records naming graph.tested_by, graph.test_files, tests.typecheck, and nodes.prd.
tdd.green: After applying the generated documents, the gate passed and the focused test file passed 5/5 with 24 expect() calls.
tdd.refactor: Rendering and drift comparison are pure exported functions; output is sorted, byte-stable, and a second reconciliation produces no drift. The CLI is only a thin read/check/write boundary.

acceptance.criterion: tested_by is populated from the Traceability Map and test_files lists every EAP corpus file under its post-rename name
acceptance.evidence: tested_by is the sorted unique set of all established Traceability Map link scenario IDs (58 entries). test_files is the sorted unique corpus.files list (22 entries), including all five behavioural retry replacements, f001-transport-delegation, and f001-validation-audit-vulns, with no f001-retry path.

acceptance.criterion: The digest states the pinned task-01 typecheck command and the graph indexes both normative PRD sources
acceptance.evidence: docs/.digest.md now states bun run typecheck with TypeScript 5.8.2 from the lockfile and contains no tsconfig.check.json reference. docs/.graph.json contains docs/PRD/OpenGraph_Working_Paper_v1_0.md and docs/PRD/PRD.md nodes.

acceptance.criterion: Any generated-content drift fails with file, field, expected, and actual
acceptance.evidence: The pre-write --check exited 1 and emitted four DocumentationDriftDetected JSON payloads with exactly those fields. The post-write --check exits 0. Unit fixtures independently exercise stale tested_by and confirm the complete payload shape.

verification.targetAndSourceSuite: PASS - 41 tests, 0 failures, 431 expect() calls across reconcile-index and reconcile-traceability
verification.typecheck: INCONCLUSIVE ENVIRONMENT - bun run typecheck reached the pinned TypeScript 5.8.2 gate, but its nested Bun.spawnSync failed with Windows sandbox uv_spawn EPERM. No typecheck pass is claimed; the changed TypeScript was executed successfully by Bun's test runner.

decisions: tested_by includes every unique scenario participating in an established link, including covers-partially links; evidenced status remains the separate task-09 derivation.
test_files is copied from Traceability Map corpus.files rather than rediscovered or hand-maintained.
The document graph gains only the two required PRD nodes. Existing nodes and edges are preserved and deterministically ordered.
Task 23 owns composition into the unified quality-gate build. Task 21 supplies a standalone --check command with a blocking exit code without changing out-of-scope CI or package files.

scopeNotes.ciComposition: No CI or package-script edit was made; the final unified gate and Suite Verdict are task 23 scope.
scopeNotes.preservedPriorWork: All task-19/task-20 source, workflow, ledger, and report changes were preserved.
